title: Erasmus+ capacity building in the field of youth
funder: European Commission, EACEA. Call ID ERASMUS-YOUTH-2026-CB
aim: strengthening youth organisations, mainly in partner countries outside the programme, through international cooperation
amount_text: Lump sum at an 80% funding rate. Maximum EU contribution €300,000 for the Western Balkans, Eastern Neighbourhood and Southern Mediterranean, or €450,000 for Sub-Saharan Africa.
documents_text: Application documents are not listed on this page. Check the call on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal. Projects must score at least 60 points overall and at least half of the maximum in each award category.

deadline.text: 26 February, 17:00 Brussels time. The page gives no year, but the call ID says 2026, so this round has almost certainly closed.

requirements.text: Applicant is an NGO or public body working in the field of youth
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The page names youth NGOs, national youth councils and public bodies in the youth field as eligible applicants.

out: Your profile says you work with young people.
Your profile says you do not work in the youth field.
Confirm that youth work is a core activity.

requirements.text: Legally established in an eligible country
requirements.evidence_excerpt: Applicants must be established in an EU Member State or a country associated to the programme. The page refers to Part A for the country list. That Norway counts as associated is general knowledge, not something this page states.

out: Norwegian organisation. Confirm Norway’s status in Part A, “Eligible countries”.
Check your country in Part A, “Eligible countries”.

requirements.text: Consortium of at least four applicants, with two from different partner countries in one region
requirements.evidence_excerpt: Proposals need a consortium of at least four applicants: at least one from an EU or associated country and at least two from different eligible third countries in the same region. Cross-regional projects are not eligible.

out: Your partner countries are covered. Confirm that you reach four applicants in total.
You need a second partner country in the same region, and four applicants in total.
You cannot apply alone. You need four applicants, including two from different partner countries in one region.
Clarify which partners you could involve outside the EU and EEA.

requirements.text: Project mainly strengthens youth organisations in the partner countries
requirements.evidence_excerpt: Activities must build the capacity of youth organisations, principally in the non-associated partner countries.

out: This needs your judgement. The project idea must mainly serve the partner organisations, not only your own work.

title: Oslo: grants for integration work by voluntary organisations
aim: participation and integration of people with immigrant background in society and working life
amount_text: Not stated on the page we read.
documents_text: Organisations that receive NOK 200,000 or more must later file a report checked by a state-authorised auditor. Reporting uses the scheme’s own form. The list of application documents was not in what we read.

deadline.text: The page says the deadline for 2026 has passed. It gives no date for the next round.

requirements.text: Registered in Frivillighetsregisteret
requirements.evidence_excerpt: Voluntary organisations registered in Frivillighetsregisteret can apply.

out: Your profile says you are registered.

requirements.text: Project is carried out in Oslo
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The project must be carried out in Oslo in the grant year.

out: Eligible only if the project itself takes place in Oslo.

requirements.text: Project supports the scheme’s integration goals
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The aim is participation and integration of people with immigrant background in society and working life. The page lists specific goals a project must support. We read only part of that list.

out: Your focus looks aligned. Check your project against the full goal list on the page.
Fits only if the project serves people with immigrant background.
Your main field is not integration work.

title: Oslo: core funding for local immigrant organisations
aim: stronger organisations and better integration work among local immigrant organisations in Oslo
amount_text: Not stated on the scheme page. The 2026 decision document says NOK 1,734,000 was awarded in total across all successful applicants.
documents_text: Statutes must be attached, also by organisations that sent them in earlier years. Every applicant must have a member list. Recipients later file an annual report and accounts.

deadline.text: 2 February 2026, according to the 2026 decision document. The scheme page says the 2026 deadline has passed.

requirements.text: Local organisation based in Oslo
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The scheme funds local, member-based immigrant organisations in Oslo. National organisations apply to the Directorate of Integration and Diversity (IMDi) instead.

out: National organisations apply to IMDi instead.
The scheme is for organisations in Oslo.

requirements.text: Immigrant organisation
requirements.evidence_excerpt: Support goes to immigrant organisations that are member-based.

out: You describe the organisation as founded by and for people with immigrant background.
The scheme is for immigrant organisations.
Confirm that the organisation counts as an immigrant organisation.

requirements.text: Member-based, with a member list
requirements.evidence_excerpt: All organisations must have a member list.

out: You have members and a list.
Create a member list before you apply. It is required.
The scheme is for member-based organisations.
Confirm whether you have members and a list.

requirements.text: Statutes attached to the application
requirements.evidence_excerpt: All applicants must attach their statutes.

out: Have your statutes ready to attach.

requirements.text: No operating grant from another state scheme
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The 2026 decision document says no operating grant is given to organisations that already receive one from another state scheme.

out: Check whether you receive operating support from another state scheme.

title: User-run organisations working against poverty
aim: user-run organisations that work against poverty and give their members a say in decisions that affect them
amount_text: Not stated in what we read.
documents_text: Statutes are required with a first application. The page lists an email address for questions about the scheme. Recipients are prioritised for a three-year period.

deadline.text: The page says the deadline for 2026 has passed. It gives no date for the next round.

requirements.text: Registered in Frivillighetsregisteret
requirements.evidence_excerpt: Organisations and foundations that receive support must be registered in Frivillighetsregisteret.

out: Your profile says you are registered.

requirements.text: Works against poverty
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The grant goes to user-run organisations that work against poverty.

out: Your main field is poverty and social inclusion.
Your main field is not poverty work.

requirements.text: Run by the people it serves
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The grant goes to organisations driven by the target group, where users take an active part in decisions that affect them.

out: Your profile says the organisation is user-run.
The scheme is for user-run organisations.
Confirm that users run the organisation and take part in decisions.

requirements.text: Local organisations are normally co-funded by local authorities
requirements.evidence_excerpt: Locally rooted organisations are normally expected to be partly funded by local authorities.

out: This applies to locally rooted organisations. You reported national reach.
Check whether your municipality co-funds you.

requirements.text: First-time applicants show cooperation with national organisations
requirements.evidence_excerpt: First-time applicants should be able to show cooperation with national organisations and networks doing similar work.

out: If this is your first application, prepare examples of that cooperation.

requirements.text: Statutes attached to a first application
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The organisation’s statutes must be sent in with a first application.

out: Have your statutes ready to attach.

title: Oslo: operating grants for arts and culture organisations
aim: quality and diversity in Oslo’s arts and culture offering, made available to as many people as possible
amount_text: Not stated in what we read.
documents_text: Upload last year’s annual accounts and annual report, final or preliminary. To submit, someone in your organisation needs the Altinn roles “kommunale tjenester” and “Post/arkiv”.

deadline.text: The annual deadline is 1 April for the following year, and the application form opens in early February. The page does not yet announce the next round.

requirements.text: Works in arts and culture
requirements.evidence_excerpt: Organisations, institutions and businesses in the arts and culture field can apply.

out: Your main field is arts and culture.
Your main field is not arts and culture.

requirements.text: Activity takes place in Oslo
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The scheme supports Oslo’s arts and culture offering.

out: Confirm that your activity takes place in Oslo.

requirements.text: Not an excluded type of organisation
requirements.evidence_excerpt: No grants go to organisations with clearly commercial operations, fundraising as their purpose, or a scope and profile limited to the local community.

out: Check your scope against these exclusions before you apply.

requirements.text: Annual accounts and report ready to upload
requirements.evidence_excerpt: Last year’s annual accounts and annual report must be uploaded with the application.

out: Your accounts and report are ready.
Prepare final or preliminary accounts and an annual report.

requirements.text: Someone holds the required Altinn roles
requirements.evidence_excerpt: Submitting requires the Altinn roles “kommunale tjenester” and “Post/arkiv”.

out: Check who in your organisation holds these roles.

title: Tønsbergstiftelsene: general, religious and cultural purposes
funder: Foundation for Tønsberg municipality, as listed by an aggregator
aim: activities that benefit residents of Tønsberg and surroundings
amount_text: Not stated in what we read.
documents_text: Not stated. The aggregator says the final criteria are in each call on the foundation’s own website.

deadline.text: Two fixed deadlines a year, 15 February and 15 October, according to the aggregator. Its own “next deadline”, 15 October 2026, has already passed.

requirements.text: Applicant type is among those listed
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The aggregator lists associations, voluntary organisations, cultural actors, congregations, schools and non-profit businesses.

requirements.text: Activity benefits people in Tønsberg and surroundings
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The activity must benefit residents of Tønsberg and the surrounding area.

out: Eligible only if your project benefits people in the Tønsberg area.

requirements.text: Criteria in the current call
requirements.evidence_excerpt: The aggregator says final criteria appear in each call on the foundation’s website. We did not read that site.

out: Read the current call on the foundation’s own website.
